title: 第21章 指点徒弟第22章 终于来了
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“仙师！怎么样了？”门外传来穆家主急切的关心。
苏星河拍了拍穆婉清的后背，哭的梨花带雨的小姑娘这才羞怯的从他怀里出来，脸颊绯红，低着头，不敢看他的眼睛。
“好了，进来吧！”
听到苏星河吩咐，穆家主这才试着去推门，之前被振飞，虽然心有余悸，但心系女儿安危，也就顾不得了。
“咣当！”
这一次没有丝毫费力，门就开了，反而因为穆冠英用力过猛，撞击在墙上，发出剧烈的撞击声。
“成功了？”穆婉清一把搂过女儿，目光却是盯着苏星河。
“当让！”苏星河微笑。
“太好了！太好了！”穆冠英哽咽着，撇过头。
“娘！你哭了！”
“没有，风大，迷了眼！”
哽咽颤抖的声音，早已出卖了她。
“仙师，武大郎也炼气成功了？”身后胡子花白，却面容刚毅的大长老，似乎不记得武大伟的名字，小心翼翼的询问。
场中几人屏住呼吸，等着苏星河的答案。
连穆冠英，也不顾自己微红的眼眶，再次转回头，看向苏星河。
屋内静悄悄，落针可闻。
苏星河给武大郎丢了个眼色，示意他自己说。
“大长老，我......我也炼气成功了！”
众人呆若木鸡，一时间都忘了惊呼。
“真是太好了！”

良久，穆冠英憋出了质朴的五个字。
“我只能帮你们到这儿，以后成就高低，就靠你们自己努力！”
虽然两人都成功踏入修仙之路，但无论天资，还是资源，他们都无法与真正得宗门相比。
也不像自己身负灵净瓶以及仙器，他们今后若无机缘，恐怕成就有限，能不能突破炼气一层都是个未知数。
只是此刻，苏星河不想拂了他们的性质，再说，即使无法突破，炼气一层的修为，在世俗，那也是令人仰望的存在！
“是，仙师！”穆婉清抹干了眼泪，浅浅的梨涡在脸上荡漾开来！
“是，师......父！”武大伟犹豫了下，还是怯生生的喊了声师父。
苏星河眼角一挑，看了一眼武大伟，没有应，却也没有反对。
穆冠英把一切都看在眼里，当了几十年的家主，察言观色早已炉火纯青，嗔了女儿一眼，说道:
“好叫什么仙师，你看大郎多懂事，还不叫师父！”
“师......父。”穆婉清声若蚊蝇。
content_en:
"Master Immortal! How's it going?" The Mu family's anxious concern came from outside the door.
Su Xinghe patted Mu Wanqing's back, and the crying little girl came out of his arms shyly, her cheeks flushed, her head lowered, not daring to look into his eyes.
"Okay, come in!"
After hearing Su Xinghe's instructions, the Mu family leader tried to push the door open. He was knocked away before. Although he was still frightened, he was concerned about his daughter's safety and couldn't care less.
"Bang!"
This time, the door opened without any effort. Instead, because Mu Guanying used too much force, it hit the wall, making a violent impact.
"Successful?" Mu Wanqing hugged her daughter, but her eyes were fixed on Su Xinghe.
"Let's give in!" Su Xinghe smiled.
"Great! Great!" Mu Guanying choked and turned his head.
"Mom! You're crying!"
"No, the wind is strong and I'm confused!"
The choked and trembling voice had already betrayed her.
"Master Immortal, has Wu Dalang also succeeded in refining Qi?" The elder with a gray beard behind him but a resolute face asked cautiously as if he didn't remember Wu Dawei's name.
Several people in the field held their breath, waiting for Su Xinghe's answer.
Even Mu Guanying, ignoring his reddish eyes, turned back to look at Su Xinghe again.
It was so quiet in the house that you could hear a pin drop.
Su Xinghe gave Wu Dalang a look and signaled him to speak on his own.
"Great Elder, I...I also succeeded in refining Qi!"
Everyone was stunned and forgot to exclaim for a while.
"That's great!"
For a long time, Mu Guanying held back five simple words.
"I can only help you get here. Your success in the future will depend on your own efforts!"
Although both of them successfully embarked on the path of cultivating immortals, no matter their talents or resources, they could not compare with the real sect.
It's not like he is carrying the Spirit Purification Bottle and the Immortal Weapon. If they don't have the opportunity in the future, their achievements may be limited. Whether they can break through the first level of Qi Refining is unknown.
It's just that at this moment, Su Xinghe doesn't want to disturb their nature. Besides, even if he can't break through, the cultivation level of Qi Refining is still something that people look up to in the world!
"Yes, Immortal Master!" Mu Wanqing wiped away her tears, and shallow pear dimples rippled on her face!
"Yes, Master...Father!" Wu Dawei hesitated for a moment, then timidly called out to Master.
Su Xinghe raised his eyes and glanced at Wu Dawei. He didn't respond, but he didn't object either.
Mu Guanying saw everything in his eyes. After being the head of the family for decades, he had become very good at observing words and emotions. He gave his daughter an angry look and said:
"Why do you call me Immortal Master? You see how sensible Da Lang is, yet he still doesn't call him Master!"
"Master...Father." Mu Wan's voice was as clear as a mosquito.
